description: Audit given Go packages/files/identifiers (a Cobra command-line tool, library, or service) for complete Go doc comments as defined by go.dev/doc/comment — a package comment (in `doc.go` for a multi-file package; `Command <bin> …`-style for `package main`), and a comment on every exported function, method, type, constant, variable and struct field that matters, each starting with the identifier's name and written as full sentences ending in a period, with `Deprecated:` paragraphs, `[pkg.Name]`/`[Name]` doc links, and lists/code blocks in Go's doc-comment syntax — generate any missing or incomplete comments grounded in the actual code and current changes, then verify: golangci-lint v2 with a dedicated, throwaway config that enables only revive's `exported` (incl. stutter and the "should be of the form `Name …`" check) and `package-comments` rules plus `godot` (so a project config whose `comments` exclusion preset hides those findings can't mask gaps), `go vet`, and `go doc -all` per package to prove every comment renders and to catch unresolved `[Name]` doc links (which `go doc` leaves bracketed). Falls back to `go doc` + a grep audit when golangci-lint isn't installed. Never edits code, signatures, generated files (`// Code generated … DO NOT EDIT.`), `_test.go` files, or `testdata/`. Invoke as `/iru-go-godoc <packages-files-or-identifiers>` (comma-separated: `./internal/cli/...`, `internal/greet/greet.go`, `internal/greet.Greeting`, `github.com/acme/tool/internal/output.Envelope`), or `/iru-go-godoc` with no argument to scope to Go files touched by uncommitted changes plus commits on the current branch not yet on the base branch. Use whenever the user (or `iru-go-code-one-task-group` via `iru-gate-runner`) wants doc-comment completeness checked and filled in for Go code, instead of discovering gaps on pkg.go.dev after a release.
